title: desmodium tiliifolium
intro: Desmodium tiliifolium, commonly known as Showy Tick-trefoil, is a perennial herb belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium tiliifolium include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-edematous effects, making it a valuable remedy for conditions like fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium tiliifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
